variant.briefing:
Some morons with some seriously inflated notion of their place in 'verse made the damn foolish choice of attacking the [Objects] at [Location]. We've got some things in play over there so we can’t let ‘em get away with it.

If you're interesting in helpin' out, get there and deal with these luggers before they can do too much damage. Don't figure you'll break too much of a sweat dealin' with them.

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor [ScripAmount] Council Scrip just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.
